title: fix(core, objectql): the activation ledger backfill binds no row of an item that has more than one
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBA3NaMwQLyyUhZ3JekH2e6U)_

Fixes #32094

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 启动时的激活台账 package 回填,遇到同一项目有多条开关行(两条及以上不带 package,或一条不带 package 加一条已带该项目的 package)时,整项不绑定、逐行报告(行 id、package、开关值)并给出处置;其余行照常绑定。回填改为先问完所有问题再写,单行写失败只报告该行,不再中止整轮。
- **为什么改:** 18.3 → 18.4 升级路径(QA #32093):原逻辑把先存的那条绑上 package,下一次启动无 package 唯一索引就在这对重复行上建成,重复从此不再报告,生效的开关由存储顺序决定;第二条写入撞唯一键使整轮中止,排在后面的行每次启动都绑不上。
- **风险与回滚:** 只动尚未发布的回填逻辑(18.4 待发 changeset `31682`)和它的启动日志;不删任何行、不写 schema、不改开关值,重复项由运维删行后下次启动自动绑定。`@objectstack/core`、`@objectstack/objectql` patch。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** ① `packages/core/src/utils/metadata-activation-store.ts` 的 `backfillActivationLedgerPackages`(`duplicated` 判定与先问后写);② `packages/objectql/src/activation-ledger-backfill.ts` 新增的 `error`/`warn` 两行文案;③ `packages/objectql/src/activation-ledger-backfill.test.ts` 的升级用例(真实 SQLite,两次启动)。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --project local src/activation-ledger-backfill.test.ts`,预期 `12 passed`;升级用例两次启动都是索引拒建、两条重复行仍不带 package、第三条已绑定。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/core`, `backfillActivationLedgerPackages`.** The run now groups the ledger by item, `(metadata_type, name)`, and asks `holderOf` once per item before the first write. An item one package holds is bound only when it has ONE row naming no package and no row already naming that package. Otherwise it goes to the report's new `duplicated` list with the holder and every one of those rows (`id`, `packageId` when it names one, `active` read through the module's one `0`-is-false read), and none of its rows is written. Both shapes are covered:
  - two or more rows naming no package (the card's case): binding one takes it out of the package-less index's reach, so the next boot built `uniq_sys_metadata_activation_packageless` over the pair, and the second write collided with the first under the declared key;
  - one row naming no package beside one that already names the holder (what the old code left behind on boot 1, and what a door write leaves, see Acceptance notes): the write collides.
- Writes run after every question is answered. A write that is refused or fails goes to the new `failed` list with its error, and the run moves on, so one row never stops the rows stored after it. A failure before that (the ledger read, a resolver that throws) leaves the ledger as it was. `ActivationLedgerDuplicateRow` names one row of a duplicated item. The active-column read is factored into `readActiveColumn`, shared with `readActivationLedgerRows`.
- **`@objectstack/objectql`, `backfillActivationLedgerAtBoot`.**
  - `duplicated` is logged at `error`: the consequence (two switches for one item, the one applied picked by storage order, which binding would only hide) and the fix (delete the row that should not apply, by the id named, then restart; the next boot binds the row left; nothing is deleted automatically), then each item with its holder and rows.
  - `failed` is logged at `warn`, naming each row, its target package and the error, and saying every other row was handled.
  - The catch-all warning said "did not finish: rows that name no package keep naming none", which was false in the card's run. It now covers only failures that precede every write, and says "stopped before writing any row".
- No schema write, no deletion, no change to `active`, and the package-less index migration is untouched: it keeps refusing on its own because the pair stays.

## Tests

Before, at `45f0f81f` (main's core dist, real SQLite with the declared key, the backfill run twice):

```text
boot 1: backfill THREW: UNIQUE constraint failed: sys_metadata_activation.metadata_type, sys_metadata_activation.package_id, sys_metadata_activation.name; rows [{"id":"d1","package_id":"com.example.app183"},{"id":"d2","package_id":null},{"id":"d3","package_id":null}]; next boot's index: index built
boot 2: backfill THREW: UNIQUE constraint failed: sys_metadata_activation.metadata_type, sys_metadata_activation.package_id, sys_metadata_activation.name; rows [{"id":"d1","package_id":"com.example.app183"},{"id":"d2","package_id":null},{"id":"d3","package_id":null}]; next boot's index: index built
```

Pins added:

- `packages/objectql/src/activation-ledger-backfill.test.ts`, the card's reproduction: a real `node:sqlite` ledger carrying the declared `(metadata_type, package_id, name)` key, one boot = the real `ensureActivationLedgerPackagelessIndex` then `backfillActivationLedgerAtBoot` against the real `SchemaRegistry` (package `com.example.app183` shipping `app183_switch` and `app183_digest`). Rows `d1`/`d2` name no package for `app183_switch` (switched off / active), `d3` for `app183_digest`.
  - boots 1 and 2: index `conflict` and absent from `sqlite_master`; `d1`, `d2` still null; `d3` bound; `duplicated` names both rows; the backfill's `error` line names the item and both rows; no `warn`;
  - after deleting `d1` (the operator's remedy): index `created`, `d2` bound, no `error`.
  - a failed write at boot: named with its error in the `warn` line, the row after it still bound.
- `packages/core/src/utils/metadata-activation-store.test.ts`, new describe: two package-less rows are reported and the item after them bound; a package-less row beside one naming the holder is reported, nothing written; a dry run reports the same; a failed write is in `failed` and the row after it is bound; a resolver that throws on the second item leaves the ledger unwritten. The existing backfill pins are unchanged and green.

## Acceptance notes

- **`Clause-②: no` beside two new report fields.** `duplicated`, `failed` and `ActivationLedgerDuplicateRow` extend `ActivationLedgerBackfillReport`, which is exported from `@objectstack/core`'s root but not released: it first ships with the pending `.changeset/31682-activation-ledger-package-key.md`, which already declares that export under `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. No accepted input widens; the claim's `Clause-②: no` is kept as ruled.
- **Log level.** The duplicate line is `error` by the AGENTS.md degradation question (an administrator's persisted switch can silently be the one not applied), the same level the package-less index's own refusal uses for the same consequence. For the card's pair both lines print each boot; the backfill's adds the row ids and why no row was bound.
- **Adjacent, same defect class, not fixed here (out-of-scope finding for the seat).** `ObjectStoreMetadataActivationStore.setActive` with a `packageId`, on an item with two package-less rows, updates the first match and writes its `package_id`, which hides the duplicate the same way. Reading on core dist at this head, real SQLite: `rows after one door write: [{"id":"d1","package_id":"com.example.app183","active":0},{"id":"d2","package_id":null,"active":1}]` · `next boot package-less index: built`. Producers: the flow enable/disable door (`service-automation` `flow-definitions.ts`, `setActive` with the loader's package), the action door and the catalog door. What a toggle on a duplicated item should answer is a door decision, outside this card's route. After such a write this PR's backfill reports the item at `error` on every boot (the "one row beside one naming the holder" shape), though the index no longer refuses.
- `holderOf` is now asked once per item instead of once per row; it is a pure read of the sealed registry, so the answer is the same.

- Control-byte self-scan of the touched files → no hit.
